pages.content: Most companies do not lack ideas. They lack a shared view of which ideas matter most and what it will take to deliver them. Our consulting work gives leadership a plain language plan that connects business goals to specific technology decisions. We spend time with the people who do the work, review the systems you already pay for and look at how information moves between teams. The result is a roadmap with costs, owners and a realistic order of work. Better use of existing tools. We often find features you already pay for that solve problems without new spend. A plan you can act on. Each phase has scope, owners and measures, not just recommendations. How long does a strategy engagement take? Most engagements run between four and eight weeks depending on the size of the organisation and the number of teams involved. Do you only recommend things you can deliver? No. If another provider or an off the shelf product is the better fit, the roadmap will say so. Who needs to be involved from our side? A sponsor from leadership, plus access to the people who run the key processes. We keep time requests reasonable. What do we receive at the end? A written report, a prioritised roadmap and a walkthrough session with your leadership team.

pages.title: Digital Commerce
pages.description: Online stores and ordering experiences that are easy to run and easy to buy from. Storefronts built around how your customers buy and how your team fulfils orders.
pages.content: A good online store is more than a nice homepage. It needs accurate product data, a checkout that works on any phone, payment and shipping options that suit your market, and a back end your staff can manage without calling a developer. We design, build and improve commerce sites on established platforms, connect them to inventory and accounting systems, and set up the tracking you need to see what is working. Platform selection and setup Storefront design and development Product catalogue structure and data import Payment, tax and shipping configuration Integration with inventory, ERP and accounting tools Analytics and conversion tracking Simpler operations. Orders, stock and customer records stay in sync across systems. Mobile friendly checkout. Fewer steps and clear forms make it easier to complete a purchase on a phone. Room to grow. The catalogue and integrations are structured so new products and channels can be added later. Clear reporting. You can see traffic, conversion and revenue in one place. Which platforms do you work with? We work with widely used commerce platforms and will recommend one based on your catalogue size, budget and integration needs. Can you move our existing store to a new platform? Yes. We plan the migration of products, customers and order history, and set up redirects to protect search traffic. Do you handle B2B ordering? Yes. Customer specific pricing, quote requests and account based ordering can all be configured. Who owns the site after launch? You do. All accounts, code and content are in your name.

pages.description: ERP, CRM and workflow tools configured to match your processes. Configure the systems your staff use all day so they help, not slow people down.
pages.content: ERP and CRM systems hold a company together, but they often end up customised in ways nobody remembers or underused because training never happened. We help you select, configure, extend and support these applications. Our focus is on fit. We start with your processes, then set up the application to support them, connect it to the rest of your stack and make sure people know how to use it. Requirements gathering and solution design ERP and CRM configuration Workflow and approval automation Data migration from legacy systems Integration with finance, sales and operations tools User training and ongoing admin support Less double entry. Connected systems mean data is entered once and shared where it is needed. Consistent processes. Approvals and workflows run the same way every time. Higher adoption. We profile the source data, agree mapping rules with you, run trial loads and reconcile results before the final cutover. Do you offer support after go live? Yes, on a monthly basis with an agreed number of hours and response times.

pages.description: Move from scattered spreadsheets and ageing databases to a platform built for analysis. Replace fragile data setups with a platform your team can trust and maintain.
pages.content: Many companies run reporting off old databases, manual exports and spreadsheets passed between inboxes. It works until someone leaves or a number does not match. Data modernization replaces that with a structured platform that is easier to manage and scale. We assess your current sources, design a target architecture on a modern cloud data platform and move data across in stages, so reporting keeps working throughout. Current state assessment of data sources and flows Target architecture design Data warehouse or lakehouse setup Pipeline development for loading and transforming data Staged migration with validation checks Documentation and handover to your team One source of truth. Teams report from the same data rather than their own copies. Faster reporting. Queries that used to take hours can run in minutes on a platform built for analysis. Lower maintenance. Automated pipelines replace manual exports and copy and paste. Ready for AI. Clean, structured data is the starting point for machine learning and generative AI. Which data platforms do you use? We work with the main cloud data warehouses and lakehouse platforms and choose based on your existing cloud provider, skills and budget. Will our existing reports break? We plan the migration so current reports keep running until the new ones are tested and approved. How do you check the data is correct? Each wave includes reconciliation checks on row counts, totals and key metrics against the old source. Can our team run the platform afterwards? Yes. We document everything and run handover sessions. Ongoing support is optional.

pages.content: Analytics should start with a question, not a tool. We work with your managers to define the questions that matter, then build the reports, forecasts and models that answer them. That can be as simple as a well designed sales dashboard or as involved as a demand forecasting model. In every case we explain how the numbers are calculated so people trust them. KPI definition workshops Dashboard and report design Forecasting and trend analysis Customer segmentation and churn analysis Statistical and machine learning models Training for report users and analysts Clear metrics. Everyone uses the same definitions for revenue, margin and other key numbers. Earlier warnings. Trends and exceptions show up in reports before they become problems. Better planning. Forecasts give finance and operations a sounder basis for budgets and stock. Self service. Managers can filter and explore data without waiting for an analyst. Which BI tools do you support? We work with common tools such as Power BI, Tableau and Looker, and can recommend one if you do not have a standard yet. Do we need a data warehouse first? Not always. For smaller scopes we can work from existing sources. For larger ones we usually suggest a data modernization step. Can you build predictive models? Yes, where there is enough historical data to support them. We will tell you honestly if there is not. How do you make sure reports get used? We involve users from the first workshop and keep reports focused on decisions they actually make.
